units.source_text: 嵯峨尼姑庵环境倒很清静，可是只有老尼姑一个人，还雇了个老婆子白天来帮忙，非常寂寞……

en.t: The convent in Saga is certainly in a very quiet setting, but there is only the old nun there, and she hires an old woman to come help during the day, so it is terribly lonely...

units.source_text: 加上我家生意清淡，因此我觉得你那番话倒也实在。

en.t: On top of that, business at our house is slow, so I felt that what you said was quite true.

units.source_text: 像我这样一个批发商，又不是不画画稿就不能生活，更没有必要去画那种新奇的图案。

en.t: For a wholesaler like me, it is not as if I cannot make a living unless I draw designs, and there is even less need for me to draw those kinds of novel patterns.
